notes.title: Thank You
notes.content:
HyperLeague Heroes launched just over two years ago.

On release it was lacking many features and should have spent much more time in development, but over time, thanks to feedback from players it slowly grew into a much more complete and polished experience. I've grown so much as a developer and although HLH is still not perfect, I've had so much fun working on it and it's been amazing to hear some players say that it's their favorite idle game.

With that being said, there are no more major updates planned for HyperLeague Heroes. That's not to say that there won't be any, but player engagement has been stagnant for quite some time. I had hoped that it would increase by adding new enhancements and player-requested features, but that hasn't been the case, and since games cost time and money to create it doesn't make sense to keep going. At least for now.

Here are some updates that were planned:

 Alternate story path where you play from the perspective of one of the Dark Lord's generals, creating an army to defeat the HyperLeague Heroes and Earth's militaries to conquer the planet
 Doubling the amount of playable units
 Unit variants
 A Japanese-themed stage with ninja, samurai, and yokai units
 A pirate-themed stage

As of right now, 7.0 will be the last major update. In case you missed it, gambits were added to allow players to script custom ally behaviors.

I'll soon continue work on a project that I began prototyping a little while ago, and I'll use all the knowledge I gained from HLH to make the best game that I can. Thanks again to everyone who played HyperLeague Heroes over the years. Until next time!

notes.title: Archetypes, Save Slots, & Requests
notes.content:
Here's what's been added to HyperLeague Heroes since the last announcement.

Save Slots

Want to start from scratch? If you've been playing for a while you may want a fresh start since new features are constantly being added. Or maybe you want to try out different setups without committing in your main save. Now you can have up to 5 saves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/bf033f1f650845140e5c87c9ee19617197ab61ce.png

Archetypes

In one of my favorite recent updates, units can now be given archetypes which are specific behaviors that further customize the way your team battles.


 Leader - all status effects applied to this unit are passed on to all teammates
 Defender - unit is unable to use regular attacks but takes 60% less damage
 Berserker - unit is unable to use special attacks but critical hit rate is increased by +10%
 Gadgeteer - using items instantly readies this unit's special attacks
 Medic - unit heals weakest teammate each turn but becomes unable to use regular attacks
 Survivor - unit survives with 1 hp and gains 15 seconds invincibility when hp > 1 and hit by an attack that would k.o.
 Apprentice - unit is unable to use regular attacks but gains 2x exp
 Rusher - unit deals and receives 30% more damage
 Ghost - unit won't be targeted by enemies unless there are no other possible targets
 Lone wolf - attack +50% when this unit is the only active hero in the party

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/7ea17be1ea09895eeb77e5685f93fceabbbcc643.gif

Archetypes are unlocked by logging in. They can be assigned to units from the Party menu or by right-clicking in battle and selecting an archetype from the details panel.

Requests

Previously you were limited to 5 requests per day. Now you can take on an unlimited number of requests which means tons of loot and rewards are at your fingertips to speed up your progression.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/86542f591be2397cf1b88ab320589a8d0dbdc1c1.png

Spring roadmap coming soon. I'm currently playing FF7 Rebirth so taking a little break. :)

notes.title: Fusion 101 - Fuse Like a Pro
notes.content:
Fusion is key to maximizing your heroes' power in HyperLeague Heroes. The info below can be found just by playing or through the manual, but I'll compile it here for easy reading.

Where to Find Fusion Gems

Gems are obtained through:

 Scrapping equipment
 Daily login bonuses (upgradable through Base Upgrades)
 Loot Cave - they are common drops there
 The Loot Hunters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/42fc194907a3d04439f197b006ee1cd24e5b752c.png

The easiest way to earn gems fast is through the Loot Hunters. Every hour you idle with the game running (or 3 hours if the game isn't running) you'll earn an Idle Gem which can be traded for ~150 Fusion Gems. With the methods above you'll be swimming in gems in no time, easily earning several thousand gems per day.

Fusion Calculations

 During fusion, 60% of unit 2's base HP and attack are added onto unit 1's base HP and attack (see Calculation breakdown on Fusion screen)
 Once a unit reaches 10x their base HP or attack, fusing will only boost 1% instead of 60%
 When this limit is hit you may want to consider recruiting a higher-tier version of that unit since higher tiers have higher growth potential
 Repeatedly fusing the same unit type will cause the cost of fusing it to go up slightly. However, this effect may be removed in a coming update. Currently, the cost can be reset to its base value with a Phoenix Gem.

notes.title: Offline Progression & New Dungeons
notes.content:
Offline progression and new dungeons have arrived in HyperLeague Heroes 3.0.

Offline Progression

Want to super charge your squad but can't leave your game running while you're away? Now when you start up HLH your squad will receive a level boost and idle gems (1 every 3 hours vs. 1 every hour when the game is left running) which can be spent on resources, stat boosters, and fusion gems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/4edfc6419176545b73a9e2f6e1ad72a93c82f596.png

The longer you're away the more bonuses you'll get when you come back, the benefits maxing out at 24 hours. Remember that the rewards you get from leaving the game running will be better than the offline rewards, but either way your team will be stronger than when you left.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/3e9a7c1df636087803af66790cce90cbe3ca7061.png

New Dungeons

Two new dungeons have been added, the Volcano and the Desert. These dungeons are not for the weak, the monsters inside are much stronger than usual and you'll only be able to attempt these dungeons once you reach floor 20,000 or higher in the main dungeon.

And of course with new dungeons come new enemies. Empusa and Cyclops make their grand entrance, Empusa is currently playable and Cyclops will be playable soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/d861bb4be3b1b5ffdd6aa692c98857d1a16e5792.png

One Last Thing...

If you've been enjoying HLH and all of the new content that's been releasing, consider leaving a review! It helps tremendously and makes it possible for this game to receive big updates.

Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!

notes.title: v3.0: Tiers & Rebirthing
notes.content:
HLH v3.0 is live now, how're you liking it? Yesterday I covered the changes for perks and formations, today I'll go over the updates to tiers and rebirth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/d861bb4be3b1b5ffdd6aa692c98857d1a16e5792.png


 Each unit now has 5 tiers with each tier being significantly stronger than the last in base stats, potential growth, and growth speed
 Lower tiers are easier to obtain, you just have to defeat one of that enemy type, or in less common cases complete some other criteria such as finishing certain challenges
 Higher tiers have stricter criteria to recruit and cost much more

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/09cecf2e34b09cbb2797a57ed8b74de65b13ca79.png

Let's take a look at three of the same unit type, both at the max level but having different tiers.

Proxy Tier 1 HP: 12.6M / Attack: 720K, Cost: 180K
Criteria: Upgrade base to rank 2

Proxy Tier 3 HP: 124M / Attack: 7.13M, Cost: 18B
Criteria: Upgrade base to rank 10

Proxy Tier 5 HP: 445M / Attack: 25.4M, Cost: 2T
Criteria: Upgrade base to rank 20

As you can see, there are drastic differences in power so it's always best to recruit the highest tier possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/7ea17be1ea09895eeb77e5685f93fceabbbcc643.gif

This brings us to rebirthing, which is much less of an obvious choice than deciding which tier to recruit. When at level 30K you can reset your unit's level back to 1 as well as roll back any stat gains from fusion and stat boosters. However, this temporary setback greatly boosts the growth potential of your unit moving forward.

Rebirth lv. 1 units get their HP and attack boosted by 2, rebirth lv. 2 units get their HP and attack boosted by 3, and so on and so forth. Rebirthing is a big yet temporary nerf that can pay off substantially in the long run. It's recommended if you've made it far in Tower Climb and your squad can gain levels back quickly.

That covers it for tiers and rebirthing, two ways in which you can drastically increase your team's power and lead them to victory and the top of the leaderboards. Next time I'll cover the new units and dungeons added.

notes.title: Update 1.9 - Team Moves, Battle Formations, & Customizable AI
notes.content:
Recent updates have added new features and gameplay mechanics to HyperLeague Heroes.

Battle Formations

Each hero now has one of three classes, Attacker, Tank, and Support. Attackers boost the attack stat of nearby allies, Tanks boost defense, and Supports boost HP. Place your heroes strategically!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/f031dfbad8fecdbe17d8bc1e727a9c3b066066c8.png

Team Attacks

Placing allies of the same class close to one another additionally unlocks team moves. The more heroes of the same type, the stronger the team attack.


 Put Attackers close to one another to unlock HyperLeague Blitz. This puts all attackers in the berserk state where they'll do guaranteed critical damage for a period of time.
 Put Tanks near one another for HyperLeague Guard. This move grants invincibility to the entire party.
 Support heroes can team up to use HyperLeague Restore which recovers HP and grants regen for the entire party.

Customizable AI

Tailor the battle tactics of each hero in your party.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41761231/9eddf5eef6f236a7f5245c40b1ff4c60d8da9598.png

Tower Climb Leaderboards

Leaderboards have been added to Tower Climb mode. See how far you can make it and how you stack up against other players.

New Challenge Difficulty

If the standard difficulty for challenges was too easy, try Legend mode where enemies are tougher and hit much harder.

notes.title: Hero Abilities Pt. 1 (Dev Diary #1)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UtslduMSY4c;full][/previewyoutube]

HyperLeague Heroes features over 30 playable characters–each with their own unique ability that adds an extra layer of strategy to battles, collecting loot, and team building. In this dev diary we’re taking a look at a few of these abilities and the different ways they can turn the tide of battle.

Singe

Singe’s perk, Inspiring Leader, provides a 10% experience buff to all allies when he’s team leader. This makes him not only a reliable damage dealer, but an invaluable ally who can boost your team’s levels while exploring the perilous dungeons of Utopia.

Kingslayer

Kingslayer’s signature ability, Tactical Leader, reduces the special attack cooldown for all allies by 20%. Since this perk only takes effect if Kingslayer is the party’s leader, you’ll have to decide whether Singe or Kingslayer will be taking point. Make sure to choose wisely.

Ice Age

Ice Age’s stats are mid-tier all around, his HP, attack, and speed are fairly low when compared to other heroes like Vipera. But make no mistake, this hero stays cool under pressure with his perk, Icy Touch. With this ability Ice Age has a 15% chance of freezing targets every time he attacks.. Frozen enemies mean free hits, more time to cast buffs, or a chance to land that very crucial heal.

Gunslinger

Gunslinger is part vampire, and as such, he’s strongest when the sun goes down. When dusk settles, he gains 20% more experience–truly a fearsome creature of the night. So, make the most out of your time–and strike fear into the hearts of your enemies under the cloak of darkness.

Sentinel

While exploring dungeons you’ll come across Hidden Rooms, secret areas that may contain loot, shops, hidden bosses, or other surprises. Finding them is a matter of chance. Luckily, Sentinels come equipped with state-of-the-art Radar that increases the odds of stumbling upon these rooms by 50% per Sentinel in your party. If you’re hunting for valuable loot or a rare character like Hellfire, a Sentinel or two on your team might come in handy.
